```{=html}
<style>
.client-info-app {
  --client-gap: 14px;
}

.client-info-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.client-info-status::before {
  content: "";
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--site-accent-muted);
}

.client-info-status.loading::before {
  background: var(--site-accent);
  animation: client-info-pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.client-info-status.ready::before {
  background: #20834a;
}

.client-info-status.error::before {
  background: #bf3030;
}

@keyframes client-info-pulse {
  50% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.72); }
}

.client-info-section {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.client-info-section[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

}

.client-info-card {

}

.client-info-section-network { grid-area: network; }
.client-info-section-device { grid-area: device; }
.client-info-notice { grid-area: notice; }

.client-info-switcher {
  display: none;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  gap: 3px;
  padding: 3px;
  border: 1px solid var(--site-surface-border);

  background: var(--site-surface);
}

.client-info-switcher button {
  border: 0;

@media (max-width: 780px) {

    display: flex;
  }

    line-height: 1.35;
  }

  .client-info-row {
    min-height: 48px;

  }

  .client-info-label {
    font-size: 0.66rem;
  }

  .client-info-value {
    font-size: 0.79rem;
  }

  .client-info-copy {
    right: 7px;
    padding: 3px 6px;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
  }
}

  </nav>

  <main class="client-info-dashboard">
    <header class="client-info-overview app-card">
      <div class="client-info-overview-copy">
        <div class="client-info-kicker">Networking tool</div>
        <h1>Client Info</h1>
        <p id="client-info-status" class="client-info-status loading" role="status" aria-live="polite">Looking up your public network information…</p>
      </div>
      <div class="client-info-switcher" role="tablist" aria-label="Client information category">
        <button type="button" data-client-pane="network" role="tab" aria-selected="true">Network</button>
        <button type="button" data-client-pane="device" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Device</button>
      </div>

  <section class="client-info-section client-info-section-network app-card" aria-labelledby="network-details-heading">
    <h2 id="network-details-heading">Public network</h2>
    <div class="client-info-card">
      <div class="client-info-row"><div class="client-info-label">IPv4 address</div><div class="client-info-value loading-value" data-field="ipv4">Loading…</div><button class="client-info-copy" data-copy="ipv4" hidden>Copy</button></div>
      <div class="client-info-row"><div class="client-info-label">IPv6 address</div><div class="client-info-value loading-value" data-field="ipv6">Loading…</div><button class="client-info-copy" data-copy="ipv6" hidden>Copy</button></div>
      <div class="client-info-row client-info-asn-row">
        <div class="client-info-asn-pair"><div class="client-info-label">ASN</div><div class="client-info-value loading-value" data-field="asn">Loading…</div><button class="client-info-copy" data-copy="asn" hidden>Copy</button></div>
        <div class="client-info-asn-pair"><div class="client-info-label">ASDOT</div><div class="client-info-value loading-value" data-field="asdot">Loading…</div><button class="client-info-copy" data-copy="asdot" hidden>Copy</button></div>
      </div>
      <div class="client-info-row"><div class="client-info-label">Network</div><div class="client-info-value loading-value" data-field="network">Loading…</div><button class="client-info-copy" data-copy="network" hidden>Copy</button></div>
      <div class="client-info-row client-info-owner-row">

      <div class="client-info-row"><div class="client-info-label">Approx. location</div><div class="client-info-value loading-value" data-field="location">Loading…</div><button class="client-info-copy" data-copy="location" hidden>Copy</button></div>
      <div class="client-info-row"><div class="client-info-label">Time zone</div><div class="client-info-value loading-value" data-field="timezone">Loading…</div><button class="client-info-copy" data-copy="timezone" hidden>Copy</button></div>

  <p class="client-info-notice"><strong>Privacy note:</strong> Address-family checks use <a href="https://ident.me/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ident.me</a>; ASN, provider, organization, and location use <a href="https://ipwho.is/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ipwho.is</a>, with <a href="https://ipapi.co/privacy/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ipapi.co</a> as a fallback. Browser and device information is calculated locally and is not sent by this page.</p>

<script>
(() => {
  const status = document.getElementById('client-info-status');
  const values = Object.fromEntries([...document.querySelectorAll('[data-field]')].map((el) => [el.dataset.field, el]));
  const copyButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-copy]');
  const paneButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-client-pane]');
  const networkPane = document.querySelector('.client-info-section-network');
  const devicePane = document.querySelector('.client-info-section-device');
  const compactView = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 780px)');
  let activePane = 'network';

  function updatePanes() {
    if (!compactView.matches) {
      networkPane.hidden = false;
      devicePane.hidden = false;
      return;
    }
    networkPane.hidden = activePane !== 'network';
    devicePane.hidden = activePane !== 'device';
  }

  const present = (value, fallback = 'Not available') => {
    if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return fallback;
    return String(value);
  };

  function isCopyable(text) {
    return !['Loading…', 'Not available', 'Unavailable', '—'].includes(text);
  }

  function updateOwnerCopyButton() {
    const button = document.querySelector('[data-copy="owner"]');
    button.hidden = ![values.provider.textContent, values.organization.textContent].some(isCopyable);
  }

  function setValue(key, value) {
    const text = present(value);
    values[key].textContent = text;
    values[key].classList.remove('loading-value');
    const button = document.querySelector(`[data-copy="${key}"]`);
    if (button) button.hidden = !isCopyable(text);
    if (key === 'provider' || key === 'organization') updateOwnerCopyButton();
  }

  function browserName(agent) {
    if (/Edg\//.test(agent)) return 'Microsoft Edge';
    if (/OPR\//.test(agent)) return 'Opera';
    if (/Firefox\//.test(agent)) return 'Firefox';
    if (/CriOS\//.test(agent)) return 'Chrome on iOS';
    if (/Chrome\//.test(agent)) return 'Google Chrome';
    if (/FxiOS\//.test(agent)) return 'Firefox on iOS';
    if (/Safari\//.test(agent)) return 'Safari';
    return navigator.userAgentData?.brands?.map(({ brand }) => brand).filter((brand) => brand !== 'Not_A Brand').join(', ') || 'Unknown browser';
  }

  function operatingSystem(agent) {
    const platform = navigator.userAgentData?.platform;
    if (platform) return platform;
    if (/Windows NT/.test(agent)) return 'Windows';
    if (/Android/.test(agent)) return 'Android';
    if (/iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(agent)) return 'iOS / iPadOS';
    if (/Mac OS X/.test(agent)) return 'macOS';
    if (/Linux/.test(agent)) return 'Linux';
    return navigator.platform || 'Unknown operating system';
  }

  function loadLocalDetails() {
    const connection = navigator.connection || navigator.mozConnection || navigator.webkitConnection;
    const connectionDetails = connection
      ? [connection.effectiveType, connection.downlink && `${connection.downlink} Mbps`, connection.rtt && `${connection.rtt} ms RTT`, connection.saveData ? 'data saver on' : ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n')
      : 'Not reported by this browser';

    setValue('browser', browserName(navigator.userAgent));
    setValue('operatingSystem', operatingSystem(navigator.userAgent));
    setValue('languages', (navigator.languages || [navigator.language]).filter(Boolean).join(', '));
    setValue('screen', `${screen.width} × ${screen.height} px${window.devicePixelRatio > 1 ? `\n${window.devicePixelRatio}× pixel ratio` : ''}`);
    setValue('viewport', `${window.innerWidth} × ${window.innerHeight} px`);
    setValue('connection', connectionDetails);
  }

  function formatAsn(value) {
    const number = Number(String(value || '').replace(/^AS/i, ''));
    if (!Number.isInteger(number) || number < 0 || number > 4294967295) return { asn: value, asdot: undefined };
    const asdot = number < 65536
      ? String(number)
      : `${Math.floor(number / 65536)}.${number % 65536}`;
    return { asn: `AS${number}`, asdot: `AS${asdot}` };
  }

  function addressFamily(address) {
    return String(address).includes(':') ? 'ipv6' : 'ipv4';
  }

  async function fetchAddress(url) {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 4500);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      const address = (await response.text()).trim();
      if (!address || (!address.includes('.') && !address.includes(':'))) throw new Error('No IP address returned');
      return address;
    } finally {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }

  async function loadAddressFamilies() {
    const lookups = [
      ['ipv4', 'https://v4.ident.me/'],
      ['ipv6', 'https://v6.ident.me/']
    ];
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(lookups.map(([, url]) => fetchAddress(url)));
    results.forEach((result, index) => {
      const [family] = lookups[index];
      if (result.status === 'fulfilled') setValue(family, result.value);
      else setValue(family, 'Not available');
    });
  }

  function setObservedAddress(address, version) {
    if (!address) return;
    const family = String(version || '').toLowerCase().includes('6') ? 'ipv6' : addressFamily(address);
    const displayed = values[family].textContent;
    if (displayed === 'Loading…' || displayed === 'Not available' || displayed === 'Unavailable') setValue(family, address);
  }

  function normaliseIpapi(data) {
    const asn = formatAsn(data.asn);
    return {
      ip: data.ip,
      ipType: data.version,
      ...asn,
      network: data.network,
      provider: undefined,
      organization: data.org,
      location: [data.city, data.region, data.country_name].filter(Boolean).join(', '),
      timezone: data.timezone
    };
  }

  function normaliseIpwhois(data) {
    const connection = data.connection || {};
    const asn = formatAsn(connection.asn);
    return {
      ip: data.ip,
      ipType: data.type,
      ...asn,
      network: connection.domain,
      provider: connection.isp,
      organization: connection.org,
      location: [data.city, data.region, data.country].filter(Boolean).join(', '),
      timezone: data.timezone?.id
    };
  }

  async function fetchJson(url, normalize) {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal, headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      const data = await response.json();
      if (data.error || !data.ip) throw new Error('No IP information returned');
      return normalize(data);
    } finally {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }

  async function loadNetworkDetails() {
    const services = [
      () => fetchJson('https://ipwho.is/', normaliseIpwhois),
      () => fetchJson('https://ipapi.co/json/', normaliseIpapi)
    ];
    let details;
    let lastError;
    for (const service of services) {
      try {
        details = await service();
        break;
      } catch (error) {
        lastError = error;
      }
    }

    if (!details) {
      Object.keys(values).filter((key) => ['ipv4', 'ipv6', 'asn', 'asdot', 'network', 'provider', 'organization', 'ipType', 'location', 'timezone'].includes(key)).forEach((key) => setValue(key, 'Unavailable'));
      status.textContent = 'Network information could not be loaded. Your browser or network may be blocking the lookup.';
      status.className = 'client-info-status error';
      console.warn('Client Info network lookup failed:', lastError);
      return;
    }

    setObservedAddress(details.ip, details.ipType);
    Object.entries(details).filter(([key]) => key !== 'ip').forEach(([key, value]) => setValue(key, value));
    status.textContent = 'Public network information loaded.';
    status.className = 'client-info-status ready';
  }

  copyButtons.forEach((button) => {
    button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const parent = button.closest('.client-info-row');
      const text = parent.classList.contains('client-info-asn-row')
        ? values[button.dataset.copy].textContent
        : [...parent.querySelectorAll('.client-info-label, .client-info-value')]
            .map((element) => element.textContent.trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join('\n');
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        const original = button.textContent;
        button.textContent = 'Copied';
        window.setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = original; }, 1200);
      } catch (_) {
        button.textContent = 'Copy failed';
      }
    });
  });

  paneButtons.forEach((button) => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activePane = button.dataset.clientPane;
      paneButtons.forEach((tab) => tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(tab === button)));
      updatePanes();
    });
  });

  compactView.addEventListener('change', updatePanes);

  updatePanes();
  loadLocalDetails();
  loadAddressFamilies();
  loadNetworkDetails();
})();
</script>
```
